answer: Cross-epoch answer-correlation rule. Each identity must, across epochs, reproduce answers to a hidden set of probe queries whose content drifts like a dune; agents submit responses before the next epoch's probes are revealed. A sybil farm must keep every clone internally consistent with its own prior answers, since a hollow account with no coherent history fails correlation. Divergence beyond a canyon of tolerance flags the cluster. Cost: each identity needs maintained private state and replayable logs, so operators pay storage and compute per clone rather than a one-time fee.
